content.comment_body: Hello everyone! Has anyone conducted further research or development related to this topic? (refer to old discussion at [url]) I've noticed that there are modems currently available that establish VPN connections over GPRS, priced around €250 to €350. While I haven't followed up on the previous COM Server ideas (see [url]), it seems possible that using these modems with VPN over GPRS could allow a data collection application, such as [product_name] EXCEL LOGGER (see [url]), to operate from remote or even global locations. If so, this could open the door to performing [product_name] Teleservice over GPRS via VPN, as well as enabling telemetry (remote monitoring and data collection) over GPRS. These modems can also process SMSs similarly to specific models like INSYS, making it achievable to program them (e.g., with OPEN AT, JAVA, PYTHON) for communication with [product_name] devices via RS232, periodically reading the process image and transmitting the data as SMS or GPRS packets. I invite anyone interested or knowledgeable to join in—this presents a significant technical challenge! Whether or not you know how to implement it, please share if this topic interests you. Thanks in advance! Feel free to rate, thank, or send encouragement!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is exploring how VPN-equipped GPRS modems can be leveraged for remote telemetry and teleservice with [product_name] systems, specifically aiming to utilize alternative third-party hardware for broader connectivity and automated data transmission via SMS or GPRS. They highlight an interest in remote operations, data logging, and custom communication methods that extend the functionality of [product_name] devices, considering integration with non-native modems as a promising but not-yet-tested approach for expanding capabilities in remote data management.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to achieve remote telemetry and teleservice for [product_name] devices through affordable VPN/GPRS modems, and is seeking ideas and engagement from the community on integrating such third-party solutions. They hope these modems will facilitate packaging and transmitting [product_name] data via SMS or GPRS efficiently.
